description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter, including connection handling, authentication, message processing, QoS handling, subscription management, and tenant/configuration-related logic in an MQTT broker context.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit tests for verifying MQTT protocol adapter behavior, including connection handling, message processing, subscription management, tenant/config verification, and error handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks, configurations, and dependencies before each test to simulate service clients and environment.

methods.name: shutDown
methods.description: Interrupts the Vertx server after tests complete.

methods.name: testStartup
methods.description: Verifies that MQTT server startup binds to the port and sets handlers.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerFailsWithoutDownstreamConnections
methods.description: Checks that connection attempts are refused if service dependencies are unavailable.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerAcceptsUnauthenticatedDevices
methods.description: Ensures devices connecting without credentials are accepted if authentication is disabled.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerRejectsDeviceOfDisabledTenant
methods.description: Checks that connections from tenants marked as disabled are refused.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerRejectsUnauthenticatedDevices
methods.description: Verifies that unauthenticated devices are rejected when auth required.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerTriesToAuthenticateDevice
methods.description: Ensures an attempt to authenticate is made when auth is required.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerRejectsConnectionsAboveLimit
methods.description: Verifies connection rejection when connection limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testAuthenticatedMqttAdapterCreatesMessageHandlersForAuthenticatedDevices
methods.description: Checks that handlers are set up on successful device auth.

methods.name: testAuthenticatedMqttAdapterRejectsConnectionForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Verifies rejection for unregistered devices with valid credentials.

methods.name: testUnauthenticatedMqttAdapterCreatesMessageHandlersForAllDevices
methods.description: Verifies handlers are set up when auth is disabled.

methods.name: testHandlePublishedMessageFailsForMalformedTopic
methods.description: Ensures messages with malformed topics are discarded.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForEmptyTopic
methods.description: Checks rejection when publish topic is null.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForUnknownDevice
methods.description: Verifies rejection when device registration cannot be asserted.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Verifies rejection for telemetry from disabled tenants.

methods.name: testUploadEventMessageSendsPubAckOnSuccess
methods.description: Checks PUBACK is sent once downstream confirms reception of QoS 1 event messages.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageSendsPubAckOnSuccess
methods.description: Verifies PUBACK after successful downstream acceptance of QoS 1 telemetry messages.

methods.name: testUploadQoS1MessageSendsPubAckOnSuccess
methods.description: Helper to test PUBACK logic for QoS 1 messages.

methods.name: testOnUnauthenticatedMessageDoesNotSendPubAckOnFailure
methods.description: Verifies no PUBACK sent if message not accepted downstream.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageIncludesRetainAnnotation
methods.description: Checks retention annotation is included when device publishes a retained message.

methods.name: testOnSubscribeWithQos0RegistersAndClosesConnection
methods.description: Verifies command subscription setup and disconnection handling for QoS 0.

methods.name: testOnSubscribeWithQos1RegistersAndClosesConnection
methods.description: Verifies command subscription setup and disconnection handling for QoS 1.

methods.name: testOnSubscribeIncludesStatusCodeForEachFilter
methods.description: Checks that unsupported filters receive failure codes in SUBACK.

methods.name: testUploadMessageSupportsShortAndLongEndpointNames
methods.description: Verifies support of different topic naming conventions for message uploads.

methods.name: testConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Verifies connection count metrics for authenticated connections.

methods.name: testUnauthenticatedConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Verifies connection metrics for unauthenticated connections.

methods.name: testConnectionsLimitExceeded
methods.description: Ensures connections are refused when limits are exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForATelemetryMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of telemetry messages when message count limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForAnEventMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of event messages due to message count limits.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForACommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Verifies rejection of command responses upon exceeding limits.

methods.name: verifyEventMessageUsesTtlValueGivenInPropertyBag
methods.description: Checks that TTL from property-bag is applied to downstream event messages.

methods.name: verifyEventMessageLimitsTtlToMaxValue
methods.description: Verifies TTL is limited by tenant max-ttl setting.
